title: Home Protection Plans When a Customer Moves: Premise Transfer Terms
content:
When a customer holding a Home Protection Plan moves home, the plan can follow the customer to the new premise on the terms below.

## Terms

1. **Transfer.** When the customer moves, a plan whose terms allow it to move to the customer's new premise moves to the new residential premise, which must meet the plan's eligibility, including gas service for a gas line plan.
2. **Live plans only.** A premise transfer is made only on an active plan or one in waiting period. The status is read from the company's plan record before the transfer.
3. **Plan year and waiting period.** The plan year continues, and the waiting period restarts only when the plan's terms provide that a transfer restarts the waiting period.

On a transfer the plan record shows the new premise and the date of the move.

## Status at the time of the move

| Plan status | Premise transfer |
|---|---|
| Waiting period | May be made |
| Active | May be made |
| Cancelled | Not made |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

1. **Gas line plan.** A customer holding Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard moves to a home whose premise record shows no gas utility (none). The new premise does not have gas service, so it does not meet the plan's eligibility and the plan does not move there.
2. **Plan year carried over.** A plan whose coverage started on 9 April moves on 1 September. Its plan year continues to run from the 9 April anniversary; the move does not start a new plan year.
3. **Cancelled plan.** A plan cancelled before the move is not transferred.
